name: presentation-skill
summary: Source-first, editable PowerPoint/PPTX generation and content-retention QA for coding agents with local tool access.
one_line: Author outline.json, build native editable slides, check mapped source retention and layout, and inspect actual renders before delivery.
primary_audience: coding agents with local filesystem and execution tools
people who need rebuildable lab, clinical, investor, board, editorial, or operational decks
trigger_phrases: run layout QA on this deck
turn this CSV or Excel file into slides
capabilities: source-first PowerPoint generation from outline.json, with native editable text, charts, and tables where supported
compact brief, source authoring, and finalization for one-off decks
optional intake, style auditions, and saved planning workspaces
content-led layouts across 16 content variants, 13 style families, and eight composition grammars
bounded primary, alternate, and dense role layouts without a mandatory slide sequence
on-demand descriptor style context and original visual references
versioned coordinate-free Deck IR with stable semantic object identity
preserve-by-default supported text and alt-text patching for standalone PowerPoint decks
reproducible chart, table, and figure artifacts from local data
geometry, readability, placeholder, accessibility, and rendered-review checks
mapped visible-source retention checks for captions, caveats, units, denominators, table cells, and native chart values
source-pointer repair packets for focused corrections
verified render caching without stale visual-approval reuse
hash-bound human or model visual-review receipts

default_commands.quick_brief: python3 scripts/present.py brief --topic "Deck topic" --prompt "Original request" --profile auto --output quick_deck_agent_brief.json
default_commands.workspace_init: python3 scripts/present.py init --workspace /absolute/path/decks/my-deck --title "My Deck Title" --prompt "Original request" --profile auto

do_not_use_for: pure text brainstorming with no deck artifact
mutating a generated PPTX when source workspace files exist
shipping a deliverable deck without QA
ordinary chat without local execution tools
claiming synthetic design studies are benchmarks or current cross-generator superiority evidence
proof_asset_scope: External repository/release evidence, not bundled npm/plugin runtime assets. The 0.13.1 distribution/showcase update retains v0.13 proof filenames and the original 0.13.0 design-study ZIP/evidence. Examples are synthetic design studies, not benchmarks; the v0.7.0 native comparison is historical.

installation.codex_plugin_marketplace: codex plugin marketplace add siril9/presentation-skill --ref v0.13.1
installation.codex_plugin_next_step: Open /plugins and install presentation-skill from the repository-provided Presentation Skill marketplace.
installation.support_boundary: Installer-supported agents are not all tested here. No official/global marketplace curation claim. Local execution tools and runtime dependencies are required.

workflow_boundaries: One capable model can use the workflow; no required recursive agents, provider, or model-specific orchestration.
Source retention checks cover explicitly mapped visible fields, not factual truth or every possible source field.
Inspect actual rendered slides; static QA or a render cache hit is not visual approval.
Keep images and rendered figures distinct from editable native chart/table objects.
SKILL.md frontmatter uses name and description trigger phrases; aliases here are separate discovery metadata, not a frontmatter aliases field.
